ops.title: Ordinary stack cleanup can replace a running daemon without explicit recovery authorization
ops.description: Confirmed at merged b594bc4391c9aaa411cf6df9e65dce24cd084874: stackReleaseWorkspace calls cleanupDeferWorkspace -> cleanupService -> connectCleanup -> agent.Connect. A stale-version daemon triggers starter.shutdown (agent.go:391-392), ctl.Shutdown, then launch/install. cc-skills owner observed this during stack continue with a development binary. Global session policy requires explicit authorization to restart a named daemon; normal stack/worktree operations do not supply it. Read-only status uses separate agent.Reach and does not replace a daemon. No daemon was stopped or restarted during this investigation. Keep v0.87.40 feature release independent; fix the proven lifecycle boundary in a separate reviewed PR.

ops.text: Ordinary stack/worktree cleanup preserves an already running daemon across client-version changes.
Explicitly authorized daemon replacement remains available through a named recovery operation.
CI verifies stale-client behavior and read-only lifecycle isolation; no local tests or live daemon restart.
